scripts.ci-check: npm run type-check:all && npm run lint:all && npm run test:all
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:backend && npm run type-check:frontend
scripts.type-check:all: npm run type-check:backend && npm run type-check:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && (npm run lint 2>/dev/null || echo 'Backend lint skipped - ESLint not installed')
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
